title: prototype-parity theme pass
acceptance: The shared theme declares fontFamilyMonospace with 'Space Mono' first (self-hosted via @fontsource/space-mono imported in apps/web), and every numeric metric cell in the leagues and athletes tables renders in the mono face at the same Mantine text size as neighbouring text cells, right-aligned
The theme radius scale is xs 0.125rem / sm 0.1875rem / md 0.3rem / lg 0.375rem / xl 0.5rem; person avatars remain circles and organisation avatars remain radius sm

Tooltip colors are set once in the shared theme so the surface follows the active color scheme in both light and dark modes (never inverts), with a test asserting the theme-level Tooltip defaults exist

Tables render verticalSpacing sm with toolbar rows py 4 and footer rows py xs, on both the leagues and athletes tables and their skeletons, which mirror the same paddings so no layout shift appears between states

The leagues header is one composed row - title with live count, inline search input, then the pill groups - with the search never detached in the page corner; the leagues columns are ordered # | League/Competition | Key Athletes | Nationalities | Athletes | IG Reach with numeric metrics at the right edge and widths redistributed per the design doc
docs/design/DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md numeric examples (container padding table, skeleton references) are updated to the shipped density values so the doc and code state the same tokens
pnpm typecheck, pnpm test, and pnpm build pass; all changed or new strings are translated in all 7 locales

Driver-executed visual parity loop: the rendered leagues page is compared against the reference prototype screenshot in iterations - use of space, use of bold, use of color, and all remaining deltas - fixing and re-rendering until the two are visually equivalent; every delta found lands as a rule or token in docs/design/DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md in the same iteration (executed by the driver session with vision, like the MCP SQL verification - writer agents cannot compare screenshots)
notes: Executes PRD 'Amendment 2 - prototype-parity design pass (2026-08-19)'. Read docs/design/DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md 'Theme tokens (prototype parity)' first - it IS the spec, verified against the deployed prototype CSS. The theme package owns tooltip colors, radius, and the mono face; pages own layout and column order. @fontsource/space-mono is a new dependency in apps/web (same pattern as the existing @fontsource-variable/inter import in main.tsx); regular 400 + 700 weights suffice. Design-language skeleton rules still bind: bar heights stay CSS-var formulas so the density change cannot drift them; skeleton paddings must move together with the real toolbar/footer paddings. The athletes table adopts the same density tokens (state siblings across pages, not only within one page). Do not change any API contract - this phase is presentation only. Update the design doc's numeric examples in the same commit so doc and code agree (the doc's spacing tables currently state the old density). Amended post-commit at user request: acceptance gains the driver-executed visual parity loop; its findings and fixes land as follow-up commits on this phase.
review_findings:
SHOULD_FIX:
- apps/web/src/pages/sports/athletes/components/AthleteCells/cell-typography.ts:8 — CELL_TEXT_SIZE claims to be the one scale "matching the size='sm' its text cells render at", but ClubCell.tsx:21, LeagueCell.tsx:26 and AthleteIdentity.tsx:40 still hard-code size="sm"; changing the constant silently desyncs numeric cells from their peers — import it in those cells the way the leagues LeagueCells modules already do (learned rule: a constant a second module must match is imported, never restated)
- phases/07-prototype-parity-theme.json:18 — apps/web/AGENTS.md was edited (its quick-reference stated the now-wrong avatar radius="xl" and restated skeleton paddings) but the phase's files globs were not widened, so a necessary doc-alignment edit reads as scope creep in every later review; add "apps/web/AGENTS.md" to files in the same commit
- apps/web/src/pages/sports/leagues/columns/table-columns.ts:35 (and athletes/columns/table-columns.ts:27) — the ordinal/# and rank columns now render through NumericCell but keep align:"left", while DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md's typography rule says numbers right-align with no stated ordinal exception; either right-align them or record the ordinal exception in the doc so the next reader can't derive the opposite requirement

BACKLOG_WORTHY:
- P3 — DESIGN_LANGUAGE.md now asserts "One NumericCell renders every such value", but the music/artists table's numeric cells still render in the sans face; adopt NumericCell there (and promote it from pages/sports/numeric-cell/ to @repo/ui at that point, when a consumer outside sports actually appears)
- P3 — the artists table inherits the new verticalSpacing="sm" and square radius scale with no visual verification in this phase; confirm its density/loading states at desktop and mobile widths
- P3 — AthleteListLoading.tsx:119 restates the athletes table min width (944) and its per-column miw values as literals instead of importing them from athletes/columns, the same drift the leagues skeleton avoids by importing its width constants (pre-existing, untouched here)
